summary: The base reproduces the reported zero-hit. The candidate adds one interior grid-boundary checkpoint and improves supported long no_buffer prefills, but the exact three-token original scenario and every prompt below the first checkpoint grid still return a zero-token hit. This is a partial fix, not a full resolution.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual MambaRadixCache GPU device indices: minimal n-1 hit 0, full leaf hit 3, long n-1 hit without an interior checkpoint 0.
The exact minimal n-1 hit remains 0. Invoking the candidate insertion helper for a 128-token path yields exactly 64 GPU indices equal to the independent range [0, 63].
Candidate regression suite: 15 passed, including tests that explicitly retain the short-prompt zero-hit contract.
Surrounding Mamba and registry regression coverage: 40 passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Changed Python sources compile and the candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, HIP 7.2.26015. Actual cache-return tensors were compared with independent torch.arange references on device.
native_rebuild_reason: No native C++/HIP/FlyDSL source changed; repository-environment.json reports native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: The original [A,B,C] then n-1 [A,B] lookup still returns zero indices.
Prompts with no interior state/page grid boundary (64 tokens or fewer in the tested configuration) still return zero on an identical fresh-prefill n-1 lookup.
A shared-prefix divergence before the deepest retained interior checkpoint cannot reuse that structurally matched prefix.
The candidate is disabled for speculative decoding, ReplaySSM, int8 checkpoints, extra_buffer, and unified Mamba+SWA trees.
remaining_limitations: No prepared hybrid-Mamba model weights were available, so end-to-end logits, scheduler-to-model state snapshots, and latency were not validated.
The GPU probe validated actual cache tensors and the new insertion helper, not a full serving process.
The candidate changes only Python; native rebuild validation was not applicable.
